instruction.text: Fill in the gap with the correct sign.

atoms.a:
Maya’s dog weighs 8 kg. Each day, he needs 10 g of food per kilogram that he weighs.

If Maya has 6.4 kg of food left, how long will it last?
atoms.b: Amount of food needed per day: <mat><gap>8 10</gap> * <gap>10 8</gap> = <gap>80</gap></mat> g
How long the food will last: <mat><gap>6400</gap>`g`:<gap>80</gap>`g`=?</mat>

atoms.a: How can this division be simplified?

atoms.b: The food will last <mat><gap>80</gap></mat> days — or <mat><gap>11</gap></mat> weeks and <mat><gap>3</gap></mat> days.

atoms.a:
A scout group made up of 11 scouts, who weigh on average 33 kg, want to cross the bridge. The bridge can only hold 400 kg.

Can the scouts all cross the bridge at the same time?

atoms.b: The scouts ((++can can’t)) cross the bridge at the same time.

atoms.a:
The scouts are also each carrying a 5-kilogram backpack.

Can the bridge still hold their weight?

atoms.b: While wearing their backpacks, the scouts ((can ++cannot)) cross the bridge at the same time.
